tax.text: He proposes taxing the top 0.1% to help end homelessness and says working people should pay less while the rich pay their share.
tax.quote: And by adding a small tax on the super-rich—the top 0.1%—we can help end homelessness for good.

wages.text: He says the minimum wage has not kept pace with living costs and calls for laws that raise wages.
wages.quote: We need fair laws that raise wages, make sure everyone gets equal pay for equal work, and treat all workers fairly.

guns.text: He says he supports Second Amendment rights while also supporting unspecified common-sense reforms.
guns.quote: I am committed to preserving our 2nd Amendment rights while fighting for common sense reform.

abortion.text: He names bodily autonomy among the rights he says should be protected by laws treating people equally.
abortion.quote: That means fair pay, equal rights, bodily autonomy, and protecting people from hate, while still respecting free speech.

health.text: He supports expanding Medicare and moving toward health care for everyone.
health.quote: We can fix this by expanding Medicare and moving toward healthcare for everyone.

tax.text: Westerman says taxes should be kept lower and points to his participation in tax cuts.
tax.quote: In order to create jobs and grow prosperity, we must keep taxes lower, so that individuals can invest into their small businesses and families can make ends meet.

wages.text: He voted against passage of the Raise the Wage Act in 2019.
wages.quote:

immigration.text: He has called for strict border security and criticized actions that weakened immigration enforcement.
immigration.quote: In President Biden’s first 100 days in office, he took 94 executive actions to weaken our immigration policies, including halting construction of the border wall.

guns.text: He voted against passage of the Bipartisan Background Checks Act in 2019 and 2021.
guns.quote:

MORE Act

health.text: His Fair Care Act proposal included both private insurance and public health insurance as ways to cover more people and lower costs.
health.quote: The goal of the Fair Care Act is simple; cover more Americans and lower the costs they pay for healthcare both through their private plans and the public health insurance they fund through their tax dollars.

energy.text: He argued that expanding American energy supply would lower consumer prices and support economic growth and jobs.
energy.quote: This surge in supply directly contributes to lower prices for consumers, stimulates economic growth, and creates more job opportunities – all things that my constituents and Americans across the country need.

voting.text: He voted nay on the For the People Act of 2021, which included measures to expand access to the ballot box.
voting.quote: An Act To expand Americans’ access to the ballot box, reduce the influence of big money in politics, strengthen ethics rules for public servants, and implement other anti-corruption measures for the purpose of fortifying our democracy, and for other purposes.
